leadingHypothesis.name: Creator Rights & Revenue Kit — UGC Usage & Payment Control Workbook
leadingHypothesis.format: downloadable Excel/Google Sheets workbook + PDF playbook + editable communication templates
leadingHypothesis.buyer: UGC creators with 2-3 or more paid collaborations who manage their own usage rights, invoices and follow-ups
leadingHypothesis.job: record per-asset usage terms and expiry; log public evidence when relevant; track invoice due dates; support clear renewal/payment follow-up
leadingHypothesis.differentiatorHypothesis: evidence-to-action workflow, not only a generic deal tracker: written-scope fields, public ad-evidence log, rights-window review, invoice follow-up workflow, and no-subscription spreadsheet
leadingHypothesis.recurringModel: not selected; only explore software/membership if repeated use and explicit ongoing demand are demonstrated
leadingHypothesis.confidence: medium evidence for problem category; low evidence for specific product willingness to pay
